title: Rating
description: Displays a score as five stars on any scale, and collects scores with mouse or keyboard.

props.name: max
props.description:
Highest score; the score is always drawn on 5 stars (half stars for
fractions between 0.25 and 0.75 of a star)

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the score (one decimal) after the stars

props.name: ratingCount
props.description: Number of ratings, shown after the score when showValue is set

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Forces display mode even with a `change` / `update:modelValue` listener
(which makes the rating interactive: hover previews, half-star clicks,
a keyboard slider)

props.name: dimensions
props.description: Dimensions to rate, one row each

props.name: max
props.description: Highest score shared by every dimension

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Forces display mode even with a `change` listener (which makes the rows
interactive)

props.name: showValue
props.description: Shows the score at the end of each row

vars.description: Color of the empty stars and of the unfilled half

vars.name: --rating-gap

vars.name: --rating-value-font-size
vars.description: Font size of the numeric value (every size)

vars.name: --rating-scale-gap

<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from "vue";
import { RatingScale } from "minerva-design/vue";
const dimensions = ref([
  { key: "quality", label: "Quality", value: 8 },
  { key: "speed", label: "Speed", value: 6 },
  { key: "support", label: "Support", value: 9 },
]);
</script>
<template>
  <RatingScale
    :dimensions="dimensions"
    @change="
      (key, value) => {
        dimensions = dimensions.map((item) =>
          item.key === key ? { ...item, value } : item,
        );
      }
    "
  />
</template>

translationResources.title: Rating
translationResources.description: Displays a score as five stars on any scale, and collects scores with mouse or keyboard.

basic.title: Display
basic.description: Read-only ratings on a 10- or 5-point scale, with the value and the number of ratings.

interactive.title: Interactive
interactive.description: With onChange the rating becomes a slider: hover to preview, click the left or right half of a star, or use the keyboard: arrows step half a star (in RTL Arrow Left increases), Page Up / Page Down one whole star (max / 5), Home / End jump to 0 / max.

scale.title: Rating scale
scale.description: RatingScale rates several dimensions on one shared scale.

RatingProps.max: Highest score; always drawn on 5 stars
RatingProps.showValue: Shows the score after the stars
RatingProps.ratingCount: Number of ratings, shown after the score
RatingProps.readOnly: Forces display mode even when onChange is set
RatingProps.onKeyDown: Called before the built-in stepping; preventDefault() takes over a key

basic.title: Display
basic.description: Without interactive the stars are display-only (role="img"), like the React Rating without onChange: any 0..max score on 5 stars, with show-value and rating-count after them.

interactive.title: Interactive
interactive.description: Interactive by default: click the left or right half of a star, or focus it and use the arrows, PageUp / PageDown and Home / End. minerva-change reports the new score.

form.title: In a form
form.description: The element is form-associated: the score is submitted under name, required rejects a 0 score and Reset restores the value attribute.

scale.title: Rating scale
scale.description: <minerva-rating-scale> rates several dimensions on one scale. dimensions is a JS property; minerva-change carries the key and the updated list, mirrored here in a readonly, hide-value copy.

props.defaultValue: Initial score, restored by form.reset() (the value attribute).
props.readOnly: Forces display mode even when interactive is set.
props.name: Name submitted with the form data.
props.disabled: Disables the control: not focusable, not submitted, not validated.
props.required: The control must have a value for the form to be submitted.
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message describing the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).
props.interactive: Makes the rating an interactive slider (React: passing onChange); display-only by default.

events.minerva-change: The user changed the score; detail: { value }.

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner control.
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with "".
methods.formResetCallback: Form-associated callback called by form.reset(): restores the default value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form-associated callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form-associated callback called when the browser restores the value (back navigation, autofill).

props.readOnly: Forces display mode even when interactive is set.
props.hideValue: Hides the score at the end of each row.
props.interactive: Makes the rows interactive (React: passing onChange).

events.minerva-change: The user rated a dimension; detail: { key, value, dimensions } (dimensions is already updated).
